scope: Synthetic production extension service-worker tests in mandatory npm test CI job; not native Swift or real-browser acceptance.
required_tests: a late reply cannot cross into a replacement native connection
retired port events cannot dispatch work or disconnect its replacement
a rejected handshake cannot be presented as connected
a retired handshake cannot replace current connection metadata
a port retired before its disconnect notification cannot reject the worker task
a failed initial handshake send retires once and can reconnect
